speak.error.micDenied.title: I can’t hear you yet
speak.error.micDenied.body: The microphone is switched off for Wunder Tutor. Ask a grown-up to allow it in the browser’s site settings, then try again.
speak.error.micDenied.body.adult: Microphone access is blocked for Wunder Tutor. Allow it in your browser’s site settings, then try again.
speak.error.micUnavailable.title: No microphone found
speak.error.micUnavailable.body: Plug in or switch on a microphone, then try again.
speak.error.noSpeech.title: I didn’t hear anything
speak.error.noSpeech.body: Tap the mic, wait for Tutu’s ears to pop up, then say it nice and loud.
speak.error.noSpeech.body.adult: Tap the mic, wait until it shows it’s listening, then speak clearly.
speak.error.tooNoisy.title: It’s a bit noisy here
speak.error.tooNoisy.body: Find a quieter spot or hold the device closer, then try again.
speak.error.tooShort.title: That was super quick!
speak.error.tooShort.body: Say the whole thing, slowly and clearly.
speak.error.tooShort.body.adult: Say the whole thing clearly, at a natural pace.
speak.error.network.title: No internet right now
speak.error.network.body: Check your connection. Your progress is safe — try again when you’re back online.
speak.error.service.title: Tutu’s ears need a moment
speak.error.service.body: Something went wrong on our side, not yours. Please try again.
speak.error.service.title.adult: Scoring is unavailable for a moment
speak.error.timeout.title: That took too long
speak.error.timeout.body: Checking your voice took longer than it should. Please try again.
speak.error.useDemo: No microphone on this device? Use the demo microphone
